patterns: APPSC asks AP-specific numbers lifted from the Socio-Economic Survey/press: AP PCI Rs 2.07 lakh (2021-22) vs Rs 7,781 (1960); India 2023-24 PCI Rs 1,84,205 below AP's (statement pair).
EAC-PM state-share question (AP 4.7%, Telangana 4.9%) and national PCI growth figures are typical one-number recall.
Concept A-R: PCI can fall while national income rises if population grows faster (APPSC G1).
Other PSCs ask state rankings by PCI (Goa/Haryana/Maharashtra top) - often dated and key-sensitive.
App MCQs cover AP-India PCI tables, Telangana comparisons and district disparities in more detail than PYQs; some items rest on revisable estimate series.
